mapper.sql: SELECT 'DCC_DISTRIBUTION' AS source_id, LPAD(CAST(p.id AS CHAR),20,'0') AS row_order_key, CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS business_id, CONCAT('DCC_DISTRIBUTION:', p.id) AS task_key, '文控' AS task_type, '文控分发' AS source, CONCAT('请签收《', CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(f.title), '') IS NULL THEN '文件名称缺失' WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(f.file_number), '') IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(TRIM(f.title), CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(f.file_number)) + 1) IN (CONCAT(TRIM(f.file_number), '-'), CONCAT(TRIM(f.file_number), ' ')) AND NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(f.title), CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(f.file_number)) + 2)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(f.title), CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(f.file_number)) + 2)) ELSE TRIM(f.title) END, '》', CHAR(10), CONCAT('文件编号：', CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(f.file_number), '') IS NULL THEN '文件编号缺失' ELSE TRIM(f.file_number) END, '｜版本：', CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(f.version_no), '') IS NULL THEN '文件版本缺失' ELSE TRIM(f.version_no) END)) AS detail, '待签收' AS status_label, f.published_time AS created_at, NULL AS due_at, CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS controlled_file_id, CAST(d.id AS CHAR) AS distribution_id , f.version_no AS version_no, f.process_instance_id AS approval_process_instance_id FROM dcc_controlled_file_distribution_recipient p JOIN dcc_controlled_file_distribution d ON d.id = p.distribution_id AND d.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND d.deleted = 0 JOIN dcc_controlled_file f ON f.id = d.controlled_file_id AND f.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE p.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.user_id = #{q.userId} AND p.acknowledged_at IS NULL AND d.distribution_medium = 'PUBLIC_FOLDER' AND f.status IN ('ACTIVE','SUPERSEDED','OBSOLETE')
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM (SELECT r.* FROM () r ) r WHERE 1 = 1 LIMIT #{fetchLimit}
mapper.sql: SELECT 'DCC_TRAINING' AS source_id, LPAD(CAST(p.id AS CHAR),20,'0') AS row_order_key, CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS business_id, CONCAT('DCC_TRAINING:', p.id) AS task_key, '文控' AS task_type, '文控培训' AS source, CONCAT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.accumulated_view_seconds,0) >= CASE WHEN p.required_view_seconds > 0 THEN p.required_view_seconds ELSE 600 END THEN '请确认完成文件培训《' ELSE '请学习文件《' END, CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(f.title), '') IS NULL THEN '文件名称缺失' WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(f.file_number), '') IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(TRIM(f.title), CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(f.file_number)) + 1) IN (CONCAT(TRIM(f.file_number), '-'), CONCAT(TRIM(f.file_number), ' ')) AND NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(f.title), CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(f.file_number)) + 2)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(f.title), CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(f.file_number)) + 2)) ELSE TRIM(f.title) END, '》', CHAR(10), CONCAT('文件编号：', CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(f.file_number), '') IS NULL THEN '文件编号缺失' ELSE TRIM(f.file_number) END, '｜版本：', CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(f.version_no), '') IS NULL THEN '文件版本缺失' ELSE TRIM(f.version_no) END)) AS detail, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.accumulated_view_seconds,0) >= CASE WHEN p.required_view_seconds > 0 THEN p.required_view_seconds ELSE 600 END THEN '待确认' ELSE '待学习' END AS status_label, f.published_time AS created_at, NULL AS due_at, CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS controlled_file_id FROM dcc_controlled_file_training_progress p JOIN dcc_controlled_file f ON f.id = p.controlled_file_id AND f.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE p.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.user_id = #{q.userId} AND p.acknowledged_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM (SELECT r.* FROM () r ) r WHERE 1 = 1 LIMIT #{fetchLimit}
